policies.title: Surinamese ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table expressly lists Suriname as eligible for a visitor visa on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Surinamese passport holder travelling as a short visitor; the table states that the arrival visa costs 40 JOD.
Jordan's live page says non-Jordanian travellers must complete Gateway2Jordan registration and receive a QR code before departure.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, particular border-crossing restrictions and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Jordan Tourism Board visa requirements
steps: Complete the required Gateway2Jordan registration and receive its QR code before departure.
Present the ordinary Surinamese passport at a Jordanian arrival point that issues visitor visas.
Pay the stated 40-JOD arrival-visa fee and satisfy immigration's final admission requirements.

policies.title: Surinamese ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly puts Suriname in the authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular approval unless the separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Surinamese passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Submit the authorized-visa application and listed documents before travel to the competent Panamanian consulate; the Embassy says approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, consular-jurisdiction requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Submit the listed authorized-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Travel only after the consular visa has been granted and carry all required supporting documents.

policies.title: Surinamese ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free visitor entry
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule expressly classifies Suriname as requiring no visa for entry.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Surinamese passport holder visiting Grenada; the schedule defines 'No Visa Required' as 'Visa not required for entry'.
The schedule does not state one Surinamese stay limit; it says visitor permission beyond an approved 14-day, 30-day, 60-day, 90-day or six-month period requires a visa.
Work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside scope; admission remains subject to Grenada immigration control.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
